items.raw_excerpt: Harvard Business School is selling an eight-week entrepreneurship course for US$699 built around AI video avatars of seven of its faculty members.
items.summary_en: Harvard Business School created AI video avatars of seven professors. The school sells an eight-week entrepreneurship course featuring these digital clones for $699.
items.summary_ko: 하버드 경영대학원이 7명 교수의 AI 비디오 아바타를 만들었습니다. 이 디지털 클론을 활용한 8주 과정 창업 강좌를 699달러에 판매하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Harvard clones 7 professors with AI doppelgangers, sells access for $699
items.title_ko: 하버드, AI 클론으로 교수 7명 복제해 699달러에 판매
items.title_original: Harvard clones 7 of its professors with AI doppelgangers, sells access to them for $699

items.raw_excerpt: Dak Lak, home to Vietnam's largest durian growing area, has entered peak season, and thousands of container trucks converge on collection points every day, backing up National Highway 26 for kilometers.
items.summary_en: Dak Lak, Vietnam's biggest durian growing area, is in peak season. Container trucks line up at collection points every day, backing up National Highway 26 for many kilometers. It took trucks 2 hours to cross just 30 km.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 최대 두리안 재배 지역인 닥락성이 성수기에 들어섰다. 매일 수천 대의 컨테이너 트럭이 수집 지점에 몰려들면서 26번 국도가 수 킬로미터로 꼬였다. 트럭이 30km를 건너는 데 2시간이 걸릴 정도로 정체가 심했다.
items.title_en: Durian trucks jam highway for 2 hours
items.title_original: Vietnam's durian capital is so busy it takes trucks 2 hours to cross 30 km
